A little backstory

So, why Playlists?

I’m Ashley Glover. I grew up hearing some pretty good music stories, and somewhere along the way I realized the songs themselves were only half of it.

My dad spent nearly forty years in the record business. At home, that meant platinum records on the walls, guitars in every room, and a recording studio that kept rocking long after my bedtime.

These days, I get to sit down with musicians, people behind the scenes, and Dad himself to talk about the songs and the stories that come with them.
